map.A/B/C 类建筑修正有什么意义？: What is the point of the category A/B/C building correction?
map.→ 打开地震烈度评估（GB/T 17742）工具: -> Open the seismic intensity assessment (GB/T 17742) tool
map.依据中国地震烈度表(GB/T 17742-2020)，输入地震动参数与宏观破坏现: Following the Chinese seismic intensity scale (GB/T 17742-2020), enter the ground motion parameters and macro damage phenomena to determine the seismic intensity grade (I to XII) automatically.
map.同样程度的破坏，在不同抗震设防类别建筑上对应的烈度不同——B类（如乙类，重要建筑: The same degree of damage maps to different intensities on buildings of different seismic fortification categories - category B (such as class B, important buildings) maps the same damage to an intensity one degree higher, and category C (class C) two degrees higher - reflecting differences in structural resistance so the intensity assessment better matches real earthquake damage.
map.建筑类型修正：选择建筑类别（A/B/C 类），震害指数对应烈度按 B类+1、C类: Building type correction: choose the building category (A/B/C); the intensity corresponding to the damage index is corrected by +1 for category B and +2 for category C, reflecting differences in structural seismic resistance.
map.按 GB/T 17742 阈值：PGA≥180→7度、≥350→8度、≥700→: Following the GB/T 17742 thresholds: PGA >= 180 -> intensity 7, >= 350 -> 8, >= 700 -> 9; PGV >= 15 -> 8, >= 30 -> 9, >= 80 -> 11, and so on (see the threshold table built into the tool). Each physical quantity gives a reference intensity independently, and the higher combined value is taken.
map.灾情初判：根据判定烈度（I~XII 度）对应描述（如 VIII 度「房屋严重破坏: First-pass disaster judgement: use the description matching the determined intensity (I to XII, for example intensity VIII "severe damage to buildings, some collapse") to form a rapid disaster assessment and response recommendation.
map.烈度怎么从 PGA/PGV 换算？: How is intensity converted from PGA/PGV?
map.现场烈度速评：输入峰值加速度 PGA、峰值速度 PGV、震害指数与宏观现象（人感: Rapid on-site intensity assessment: enter the peak ground acceleration PGA, peak ground velocity PGV, damage index and macro phenomena (how it felt, how objects reacted, ground effects), and the tool determines the seismic intensity from multiple indicators per GB/T 17742.
map.震源（机制/解/应力场）分析: Focal source (mechanism / rupture / stress field) analysis

PGA gives intensity 7, PGV gives intensity 8, the damage index 0.35 gives intensity 8 (no correction for category A), and the macro phenomena give max(4+2, 3+3, 3+3, 4+4) = 8. Taking the highest and capping at 12 gives intensity VIII (severe damage to buildings, some collapse), showing that this event was dominated by the velocity measure and structural damage and reached intensity VIII.
